## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
One Important fix remains: AGENTS.md still tells contributors to run `make test`, a target this pull request removes. The guide says those commands are the only checks a change gets, so this break matters.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- AGENTS.md:24 — comments — Update the AGENTS.md push step to `make check` — After this rename, following AGENTS.md's instruction "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." fails with no rule to make target `test`. That happens because Makefile:6 now defines only `check`, and the new Layout bullet at AGENTS.md:12 lists only `check` and `lint`. — Contributors who follow the guide get a make error instead of the pytest run, and AGENTS.md:26 says that run is the only test check a change gets.
